name: What is the process for Frasheski Construction to handle hardware and functional adjustments?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for Frasheski Construction to handle hardware and functional adjustments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process involves a final walkthrough with the client to identify any areas needing adjustment. We then systematically address each item, ensuring all components meet our quality standards and client expectations. We use appropriate tools and techniques to make precise adjustments, followed by a final check for proper operation and aesthetic alignment. Our goal is your complete satisfaction with every detail.
acceptedAnswer.description: We conduct a final walkthrough with you, address all identified adjustments, and perform precise work to ensure proper operation and alignment.
